skills.description: This skill should be used when building a single-file, offline HTML website/report from an Excel (.xlsx) table — especially recurring reports where the user uploads a new file each period (e.g. weekly bank-flow / 周报 queries). Covers: reading xlsx with pandas (header on row 2 → header=1), normalizing rows, embedding normalized data as `const DATA = {...}` in a `<script>` tag with `</script>` escaping, inlining SheetJS for browser-side upload parsing, IndexedDB (localStorage fallback) for per-key / per-period storage, user-defined custom categories, clean amount display with click-to-copy, a scrollable searchable dropdown (replacing <datalist>), and a layered classification pipeline (autoCat → expand internal transfers, then explicit RPA classification, then dictReClassify via keyword rules). Also covers HTTPS publishing via the sites skill and the python-venv gotcha on this machine.
